verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API that exposes deployment functions as callable endpoints, plus a CLI (`npx convex run/import/insights`) and a dedicated MCP server explicitly built for AI agents to interact with deployments — directly satisfying an AI-native driver story. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) was probed and returned 404s, so discoverability is via prose docs rather than a standard schema.
